intent.raw: Design the separately owned EVF-to-factory obligation/evidence adapter selected by FMP-EVF-B, using one bounded native helper.
intent.objective: Author and deterministically validate a private Design candidate that preserves EVF obligation meaning, factory lifecycle ownership, provider semantic ownership, claim ceilings, and exact downstream owner gates.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route crosses EVF, architecture-conformance factory, TLA/TLC provider, Invoke validation, and one delegated helper while carrying private owner-gated Design context.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: All writes remain inside the declared private run, every authority effect remains none, protected owner choices remain gates, and the helper returns a structured receipt to the parent.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The user explicitly requested route 2 through a subagent and repository AGENTS.md routes one bounded helper as a native helper rather than a governed multi-agent graph.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One artifact-only helper can author and validate the separate adapter Design while the parent owns the six-unit provider Plan, user communication, helper join, and final cross-route claims.
context: The topology is already selected by exact owner decision.
The helper has one fresh private write root and no authority over existing EVF, factory, FMP, Craft, Arcanum, telemetry, Git, or external state.
No nested agents or parallel waves are required.

roles.purpose: Author the bounded Invoke Design bundle, run deterministic Design selection, Distill the Design unit, validate exact scope, and return one receipt.
roles.owns: This run-local Design candidate and helper receipt only

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: do 1 and 2 2 with a sub agent

steps.name: Build strict Design context

inputs.ref: accepted FMP-EVF-B decision and delegated Invoke Design request

stop_conditions: stop if any of eight obligations lacks selector-level evidence or explicit resolution

steps.name: Resolve remaining Design ambiguity without reopening owner decisions

capability_metadata.validation_note: Repository-installed canonical ID is selected through its generated native package.

stop_conditions: stop rather than infer any exact protected schema or assignee choice

steps.name: Select exact Invoke Design templates

capability_metadata.validation_note: Repository-installed capability is used in lookup-only mode without Inventory mutation.

stop_conditions: stop on an unresolved profile tie or missing template evidence

steps.name: Author six-view adapter Design candidate
stop_conditions: stop on Plan/SWU content, implementation instructions, current invocation claims, authority expansion, or owner-choice inference

steps.name: Run exact Design denominator and two-pass selection
stop_conditions: stop unless source digests, total bindings, owners, legal dispositions, and fixed point pass

steps.name: Validate the smallest coherent Design unit
stop_conditions: stop if splitting the adapter hides currentness glue or if the unit imports factory/provider lifecycle

steps.name: Validate exact run-local artifacts and return helper receipt
stop_conditions: stop on out-of-scope writes, stale sources, invalid JSON, whitespace/symlink defects, or an inflated claim

gates.condition: Eight of eight Design obligations are covered by exact sources or explicit exclusions.
Manifest, denominator, total concern binding, selected outputs, ownership, and two immutable passes validate.
Exact schemas, fixtures, role assignments, execution, authority, promotion, and release remain outside this helper.
The helper returns one complete receipt and the parent owns join, closeout, and final claims.

boundaries.contract: Write only the declared fresh Design run root and return one receipt.
Design may name minimum bindings and role gates but may not accept exact protected contracts or transfer authority.

authority.validation: installed Invoke validators and parent review

state_namespaces.write_policy: only this fresh run root; all product, governance, public, telemetry, and Git surfaces remain read-only

promotion_splits.target: accepted schema, Plan, implementation, execution, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production
promotion_splits.rule: No transition occurs without separately owned exact acceptance and downstream lifecycle receipts.

observability.signal_grouping: run-local dispatch_id and step_id; no telemetry append authorized

promotion_guardrails: No selected source proves EVF invokes FMP today.
Design validators prove only exact source/selection closure.
Planned validators and fixtures are unimplemented and unexecuted Design contracts.
No product, Plan, SWU, Craft, authority, Arcanum, telemetry, Git, release, deployment, or production effect is authorized.
